text:
Asha Iyer: FYI we noticed a spike in billed tokens for Mar 10-11 after invoices went out. Preliminary look shows ~34k extra tokens across 4 accounts. Suspect duplicate replay from our Kafka retry loop.

Diego Ramos: Ack. Can you paste the quick query you used?

Asha Iyer: Sure: 
```sql
SELECT org_id, SUM(tokens_billed) - SUM(tokens_actual) AS delta
FROM billing_line_items
WHERE invoice_date BETWEEN '2026-03-10' AND '2026-03-11'
GROUP BY org_id
HAVING delta > 0
ORDER BY delta DESC;
```

metering-bot: alert: high-billing-delta detected. metric=token_delta_hours, value=34.1k, window=48h, source=kafka-replayer

Priya Nair: We saw a similar duplex replay bug in staging when a consumer crashed and the ack logic retried messages that were already applied. I can triage idempotency gaps on the ledger side.

Owen Brooks: I'll take ownership of the retraction/credit flow with billing. Steps I propose: 1) freeze billing queue for affected invoices 2) run ledger reconciliation job 3) prepare invoice adjustments/credit memos 4) notify customers + CSMs. ETA: freeze + recon by EOD today, credits by tomorrow noon.

Diego Ramos: Root cause notes: retry backoff misconfigured in kafka-replayer (max-attempts=5) combined with non-idempotent ledger apply. Replayer duplicate detection missed because message checksums weren't stored when ledger applied.

Asha Iyer: Affected orgs (sanitized): org-450 delta=14800, org-772 delta=9200, org-118 delta=7400. Totals ~34.4k tokens.

Priya Nair: Concrete action items (owner / ticket / ETA):
- [x] Incident triage & evidence capture (Asha) - ticket FIN-7891 - done
- [ ] Disable auto-replay for 2026-03-10 window (Diego) - ETA 2026-03-12T16:00Z
- [ ] Run ledger dedupe & reconciliation (Priya) - job ledger-dedupe-3041 - ETA after replay disabled
- [ ] Bill queue freeze + invoice hold (Owen) - ETA 2026-03-12T17:00Z
- [ ] Draft credit memos & legal review (Owen + Legal) - ETA 2026-03-13T12:00Z
- [ ] Customer comms + CSM sync (Asha + CSM-bot) - ETA 2026-03-13T15:00Z
- [ ] Postmortem & long-term fixes: checksum persist + idempotent apply (Diego) - draft by 2026-03-19

Diego Ramos: Commands I'm running: 
```bash
# quick dry-check for duplicate messages
./kafka-replayer --topic tokens --from 2026-03-10T00:00:00Z --to 2026-03-12T00:00:00Z --dry-run --detect-duplicates
```
Dry run shows 37210 events flagged as potential duplicates; checksum hits=34200.

metering-bot: INFO: kafka-replayer-dryrun - duplicates=37210, checksums_matched=34200

Priya Nair: Starting dedupe job: ledger-dedupe-3041. Will post sample diff for org-450 when ready.

Owen Brooks: Billing queue frozen. Holding invoices with ids: inv-9921, inv-9933, inv-9947. Will unfreeze once ledger reconciliation complete.

Asha Iyer: Please include exact credit amounts in both tokens and USD. Finance needs the USD line for refund/credit memos. Use rate $0.00035 per token for these classes (same as billing table).

Priya Nair: Dedupe sample for org-450 (sanitized): before=reported 58,300 tokens, after=43,500 tokens, delta=14,800. ledger-dedupe-3041 applied 14800 token removal to pending ledger adjustments.

Owen Brooks: Draft customer message (brief): 
"We discovered an internal processing issue that temporarily resulted in duplicate usage records being billed for March 10-11. We've corrected your ledger and issued a credit of $5.18 to your account. Apologies for the inconvenience; reach out to billing@redwood.com for questions."

Priya Nair: Legal asked to avoid mentioning "duplicate" and instead say "processing error resulted in an overcount." Also include: "No customer data was exposed."

Asha Iyer: Good call. Also flag CSMs for empathetic outreach on higher-dollar accounts. @CSM-bot can you spawn a CSM alert for the three orgs?

CSM-bot: action: spawn-csm-alerts for org-450, org-772, org-118 assigned to CSM group north-america. Link: https://redwood.internal/csm/alerts/1950012345

Diego Ramos: I've pushed a short-term mitigation: lower kafka-replayer max-attempts=2 and enable a temporary checksum-store feature flag. Will follow up with a PR to make ledger apply idempotent (ticket INF-4655).

Owen Brooks: Legal signoff received on credit language. Preparing credit memos now.

billing-bot: INFO: credit-memos queued: cm-2201, cm-2202, cm-2203. Awaiting final approval to post to invoices.

Priya Nair: Reconciliation complete. ledger-dedupe-3041 job finished: removed 34,400 duplicate tokens across 3 orgs. Verification file: https://redwood.internal/finance/reconcile/ledger-dedupe-3041.csv

Asha Iyer: Posted USD conversions: org-450 $5.18, org-772 $3.22, org-118 $2.59. Total credit $11.0.

Owen Brooks: Credits applied and invoices updated. Billing queue unfrozen. invoice adjustments applied: inv-9921 adj-2201, inv-9933 adj-2202, inv-9947 adj-2203.

Asha Iyer: Closing notes: postmortem owner Diego Ramos. Diego to deliver an analysis with proposed permanent fixes: persistent checksum on apply path, idempotent ledger-apply, and better retry/backoff defaults. Draft due 2026-03-19. Also add monitoring: token-delta alert if >5k in 24h.

Diego Ramos: Will add those items to INF-4655 and schedule a cross-team review with SRE + Billing.

Priya Nair: Thanks team. Closing this thread once Diego links the postmortem and the reconciliation csv is archived in finance bucket.

Owen Brooks: Thanks all.
